runbooks.title: payment-api high error rate
symptoms: Error rate above 5% on the 2 minute Prometheus window
checkout-api traces fail inside payment-api charge
runbooks.detection: The detection engine opens an incident when the payment-api error rate crosses the configured threshold. The public AWS sample uses fixed numbers and does not query Prometheus.
evidence: Prometheus error ratio and p95, read by the API
Jaeger trace from checkout-api into payment-api
likelyCauses: Dependency timeout that surfaces as payment errors
safeInvestigation: Do not run kubectl from the browser
allowedRemediation: Human approval of rollback-payment-api on the local cluster only
The executor may change only demo-shop/payment-api from opspilot-demo:1.5.0-bad to opspilot-demo:1.4.2
verification: Prometheus error rate back under the threshold
Canary or bad Deployment no longer serving
Incident reaches resolved with an audit record
escalation: If the image is not 1.5.0-bad, do not force the payment rollback. Page the payments owner and keep the executor idle.

runbooks.title: payment-api latency degradation
symptoms: p95 above 300ms on the canary gate
checkout spans marked slow under payment-api
runbooks.detection: Canary analysis reads Prometheus p95 before promoting 5%, 25%, 50%, and 100%. A latency breach fails the gate.
evidence: Stage error rate and p95 recorded on the rollout
Trace duration on the charge span
likelyCauses: Slow dependency inside the candidate image
Resource saturation on the single lab node
safeInvestigation: Read the rollout stage, not a raw PromQL box
Confirm the candidate is payment-api-canary and the stable Deployment is untouched
allowedRemediation: Abort the canary through the rollout controller
escalation: If stable p95 is also high, stop the experiment and treat it as a capacity issue, not a candidate rollback.

runbooks.title: Bad release
symptoms: Error rate climbs after the lab deploy
runbooks.detection: Reliability Lab action deploys the bad image. Detection opens the incident from Prometheus, not from the button click alone.
evidence: Audit row for the lab action
safeInvestigation: Confirm the namespace is demo-shop and the name is payment-api
Read the recommendation. It must be rollback-payment-api.
allowedRemediation: Approve the constrained rollback. Reset Demo returns the lab to 1.4.2 without deleting the cluster.
verification: Telemetry recovered, then the incident resolves
escalation: Public AWS refuses the same POST. Do not retry it there.

runbooks.title: Canary failure
symptoms: Gate reports error rate above 5% or p95 above 300ms
runbooks.detection: The canary controller evaluates Prometheus at each weight. A bad candidate cannot promote itself.
evidence: Gate decision on the rollout record
likelyCauses: Candidate image 1.5.0-bad or a bad canary experiment
safeInvestigation: Read the rollout page. Do not edit the ConfigMap by hand during a gate.
allowedRemediation: Constrained abort that removes the candidate and returns traffic to stable 1.4.2
escalation: If abort cannot verify stable readiness, leave the rollout NEEDS_ATTENTION and do not guess a second image.

runbooks.title: CrashLoopBackOff
runbooks.detection: Kubernetes discovery shows the workload. OpsPilot does not exec into the container.
evidence: Pod phase and restart count from the read-only client
safeInvestigation: Read events and the image reference
Do not open a shell from the console
allowedRemediation: No generic delete or exec. For payment-api, only the known rollback image is allowed, and only when policy matches.
escalation: Any other Deployment stays read-only. Fix it in GitOps and let the local apply path stay human-driven.

runbooks.title: Dependency failure
symptoms: Caller error rate rises while the caller image did not change
Traces fail in a downstream span
runbooks.detection: Correlate the failing span service with the catalog dependency list.
likelyCauses: payment-api bad release while checkout-api is healthy
safeInvestigation: Open the downstream service and its runbook
Do not restart the caller to hide the downstream fault
allowedRemediation: Remediate the service that owns the failing span, using that service's allowlist only
verification: Caller traces succeed without an image change on the caller
escalation: If the dependency is outside demo-shop, record it and do not widen the executor.
